segments.text: In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Flee as a bird to your mountain?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD’s throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

footnotes: an horrible…: or, a burning tempest

segments.text: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
